description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1785/11 of 19.11.2012, Rathmalana D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 521002 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, village locations, and administrative divisions. The content focuses on updating land title records by expunging particulars, inserting life interest details, and amending ownership information. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land and property-related matters, specifically title registration amendments.
